scope: carrier.v1 geometry, generated corpus ray, fixtures, and interactive Lens
reasons: the phase update used the wrong sign for its claimed alignment
the operation was not well-defined on rays and MERGE could become singular for opposite representatives of one ray
the small-step statistic passed alpha=0.1 even though alpha weighted the old state, giving the incoming state 90 percent of the update
phase-like outputs depended on arbitrary coordinate pairing and permutation without a demonstrated semantic interpretation
the corpus description omitted public surfaces and included stale extracts
the page's privacy guarantee exceeded an architecture that dynamically imported third-party code

surviving_proposal.claim_status: workflow proposal; not validated as a standard or intelligence mechanism
surviving_proposal.purpose: carry public source, claim status, evidence, limits, membrane, ask, witness, and disposition together
limits: a response grants no trust, authority, consent, or source-update power
the envelope does not measure experience, understanding, intelligence, or co-protection

inquiry.question: Can collective capability increase while each participant's practical ability to perceive, contest, refuse, and author also increases, and what tradeoffs appear in concrete systems?
inquiry.normative_commitment: seek architectures that increase rather than consume each participant's ability to perceive, contest, refuse, and author what happens next
inquiry.claim_status: open; no empirical necessity or sustainability claim
inquiry.ask: Name a concrete system, operationalize one participant ability and one collective outcome, disclose who bears the cost, and provide public evidence or a counterexample.
